The '''long gun''' was a type of artillery used on wartime [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleships]].

==Description==
The gun was shaped with several barrels longer than the [[Quad turbolaser cannon/Legends|quad turbolaser cannons]] and [[heavy gun]]s also fitted to the ships.
